skill.name: shadcn
skill.description: Guides shadcn/ui work in React projects, including component selection, CLI usage, styling rules, forms, registries, presets, and safe update workflows.
skill.summary: Build and maintain shadcn/ui components with project-aware CLI guidance and design-system rules.
skill.author: shadcn

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, JSX template literals, documentation URLs, and reviewed PNG assets. The real residual risk is intentional shadcn CLI execution through package runners, which can fetch registry content and write project files. No prompt-injection attempt or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: CLI commands can write project files.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before add, apply, init, overwrite, or remote registry commands.

remediation.issue: Package runner examples use the latest shadcn CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Pin or document the expected CLI version when reproducible behavior is required.

remediation.issue: Third-party registries can introduce untrusted source code.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run, diff, and post-install file review mandatory before accepting registry changes.

content.value_statement: shadcn projects require exact component patterns and current CLI context. This skill guides component selection, styling, registries, presets, and updates.
actual_capabilities: Reads shadcn project context with the CLI info command.
Recommends existing shadcn components before custom markup.
Guides forms, dialogs, cards, tabs, icons, and chat primitives.
Explains safe registry, preset, and update workflows.
Uses docs, examples, dry runs, and diffs before component changes.
Applies styling rules for semantic colors, spacing, and variants.
limitations: Requires the shadcn CLI and a supported package runner.
Needs network access for current component docs and registry data.
Does not replace manual review of third-party registry code.
Focuses on shadcn/ui patterns, not backend application logic.

use_cases.title: Create Project UI
use_cases.description: Build pages and forms with installed shadcn components and correct composition rules.

use_cases.title: Review Registry Components
use_cases.description: Preview files, diffs, imports, dependencies, and composition before adding third-party registry items.

use_cases.title: Maintain Design Consistency
use_cases.description: Use semantic colors, variants, spacing rules, and preset workflows across a product interface.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a shadcn/ui settings card for a Next.js app. Use existing components and semantic colors.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Validated Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a profile form with FieldGroup, Field, Input, validation states, and accessible descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Registry Item
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview this registry component before installing it. Show affected files, dependencies, and risky changes.

prompt_templates.title: Merge an Upstream Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the Button component from upstream while preserving local edits. Use dry runs and per-file diffs first.

output_examples.input: Create a settings form with notification choices.
output: A component plan using FieldGroup, Field, Input, and ToggleGroup.
Validation guidance using data-invalid and aria-invalid.
Styling notes that use semantic colors and gap spacing.

output_examples.input: Add a third-party login block from a registry.
output: A preview-first workflow with dry-run and diff steps.
A review checklist for imports, dependencies, and composition.
A confirmation step before writing files.

output_examples.input: Switch a project to a new shadcn preset.
output: A choice between overwrite, partial, merge, and skip workflows.
Commands to inspect the current and incoming preset.
A warning about file changes before applying the preset.

best_practices: Run shadcn info before giving project-specific component advice.
Use dry-run and diff commands before modifying installed components.
Ask for an explicit registry or preset choice when the user did not provide one.
anti_patterns: Do not build custom markup when an installed shadcn component exists.
Do not overwrite local component changes without explicit user approval.
Do not fetch raw GitHub component files outside the shadcn workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill install shadcn components automatically?
faq.answer: It provides CLI workflows and should use confirmation before commands that write files.

faq.question: Can it work with community registries?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports named registries, GitHub registries, and registry URLs when the user specifies them.

faq.question: Does it support Tailwind v3 and v4?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads project context and adapts CSS guidance to the detected Tailwind version.

faq.question: Can it help with shadcn presets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect, decode, apply, merge, or skip preset changes with user choice.

faq.question: Does it review third-party component code?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to preview and review added files, imports, dependencies, and composition.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
